actual_view_detail: Native final.png actually displayed with original detail; identical bytes to original.png. Both QA reductions displayed at original detail.

mandatory_conditions.required: 검은 글자와 흰 단색 배경만 사용한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Black intact phrase remains correct, but faint diagonal streaking persists in the white field and thin gray parallel traces remain immediately beneath some black glyph edges.

mandatory_conditions.required: 원문 한 문자열을 각 이미지에 정확히 한 번 표시한다. 원문에 있는 두 번의 '숨'을 임의 중복으로 오판하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: One phrase, exactly five syllables; both supplied 숨 are present, no extra text.
No pictures, symbols or extra writing. Persistent faint diagonal field texture and gray lower-edge traces violate the flat no-texture requirement.

mandatory_conditions.required: 어절을 보존하고 어절 사이 줄바꿈만 허용한다. 글자 내부 구조를 장식 그림으로 해체하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: All three intact words sit on one baseline; full conventional Hangul glyph structure.

mandatory_conditions.required: 사용자가 비율을 지정하지 않았으므로 다섯 장 모두 세로 2:3으로 만든다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Measured 1024 by 1536, exact 2:3; zero relative ratio deviation.

observations.location: Central line, especially vertical stems of 과 and 사이
observations.observation: Exact phrase once, all words intact and conventional counters. Vertical stems now extend slightly farther above/below the neighbouring 숨. Copy remains clearly readable at native, 720 and 320.

observations.location: Gap after 숨과 and entire baseline
observations.observation: The wide empty interval remains the main idea; no line breaks, clipping or overlap. All words share the same reading line.
The single text phrase dominates; the word gap remains visible and no extra elements appeared.

observations.location: Large upper and lower blank fields
observations.observation: The background still has faint low-contrast diagonal streaking rather than fully uniform white.

observations.location: Bottom edges of the first and second 숨; blank field
observations.observation: Thin gray traces still sit immediately beneath lower black strokes, and the unrequested faint background grain remains.

uncertainties: The faint field pattern is subtle and its reduction between stages cannot be confirmed visually.
The changes in vertical stem height are small; they are a proportional change rather than a copy error.
residuals: Persistent faint diagonal background streaking and gray traces beneath lower glyph edges; flat white/no texture requirements are not fully met.
